name: Thales of Miletus
contribution: A pre-Socratic Greek philosopher from Miletus in Ionia, Asia Minor.

checks.lead: Thales of Miletus ( THAY-leez; Ancient Greek: Θαλῆς; c. 626/623  – c. 548/545 BC) was a pre-Socratic Greek philosopher from Miletus in Ionia, Asia Minor. Thales was one of the Seven Sages, founding figures of Ancient Greece.
